D/ [D]N VALENTINI[---] ; R/ SECVR[ITAS REI PVBLICAE]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Victory left issue, Arles mint; chipped. Reece period 19. Possibly RIC vol. 9 no. 9, if so, issue of 364-367. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: [D]N VALENTINI[---]. Reverse description: Victory standing left holding wreath and palm.
